query: chi, personalized items
sql:
SELECT corpus_id, title, abstract, canonical_venue, venue_type, year, citation_count
FROM Papers
WHERE canonical_venue ILIKE '%CHI%'
  AND (
    title ILIKE '%personalized%'
    OR title ILIKE '%personalised%'
    OR title ILIKE '%personalization%'
    OR title ILIKE '%personalisation%'
    OR abstract ILIKE '%personalized%'
    OR abstract ILIKE '%personalised%'
    OR abstract ILIKE '%personalization%'
    OR abstract ILIKE '%personalisation%'
    OR title ILIKE '%personalized item%'
    OR title ILIKE '%personalised item%'
    OR abstract ILIKE '%personalized item%'
    OR abstract ILIKE '%personalised item%'
  )
ORDER BY citation_count DESC, year DESC
LIMIT 100
